comment:
The purpose and scope are clear and the document is relevant to ADB’s operational agenda and ADB’s new health strategy.  

However, it is unclear whether this is a normative WHO/ITU product that Member States are expected to align to, a technical reference, or an advocacy document.

public.text:
The purpose and scope are clear and the document is relevant to ADB’s operational agenda and ADB’s new health strategy.  

However, it is unclear whether this is a normative WHO/ITU product that Member States are expected to align to, a technical reference, or an advocacy document.
public.suggestedRevision:
It would help to make a short statement on the relationship of the DPI-H architecture and guidance to the forthcoming Global Strategy on Digital Health 2028-2033. 

The intended audience matrix in page 4 only refers to ‘Health Ministries,’ although Ministries of Finance and National Planning Agencies appear in the narrative as important stakeholders.
